technique_name: Analyze and compare the following two paintings.
description: The two paintings of Monet's “Water Lilies” and Renoir's “Dance at Bougival” provide distinct visual impressions. Monet's artwork is composed of dreamy shades of blue with his signature impressionism. There is a great deal of ambiguity and movement throughout the painting, with the focal point being the intersecting water lilies in the center.
